## Tree.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The root nodes of the tree.
- `expanded` :: The ids of expanded nodes.
- `onExpandedChange` :: Called when a node is expanded or collapsed.
- `selected` :: The selected id (single) or ids (`multiple`).
- `onSelectedChange` :: Called when the selection changes.
- `multiple` :: Allow more than one node to be selected.
- `checkable` :: Show a tri-state checkbox on each node, with parent–child propagation.
- `checked` :: The ids of checked nodes.
- `onCheckedChange` :: Called when a checkbox is toggled.
- `loadChildren` :: Load children when an unloaded expandable node is first opened.
- `renamable` :: Allow inline renaming of nodes via F2 or double-click.
- `onRename` :: Called when an item rename commits with a non-empty label.
- `guides` :: Draw subtle vertical indent guides beside nested branches.
- `label` :: Names the tree for assistive technology.

## tree.svelte.ts

### `interface TreeItem`

One node in a tree.

- `id` :: Stable unique id.
- `label` :: The visible label.
- `icon` :: An optional leading icon.
- `children` :: Child nodes. Omit or leave empty for a leaf, unless `hasChildren` is set.
- `disabled` :: When true, the node cannot be selected, expanded or checked.
- `hasChildren` :: When true, the node is expandable even if `children` have not been loaded yet.

### `interface VisibleNode`

A visible (expanded-path) node, with its depth and parent.

### `function childrenOf`

Children of a node, preferring lazily loaded ones.

### `function isExpandable`

Whether the node can expand (has children, or can load them).

### `function flattenVisible`

Walk the tree in document order, descending only into expanded nodes.

### `function descendantIds`

All descendant ids, depth-first.

### `function findItem`

Find a node by id.

### `function asSet`

Selected keys as a Set, whether the value is a single id or a Set.

### `function toggleChecked`

Toggle a node and propagate to descendants and ancestors. Checking a parent checks every descendant; a parent is checked when every child is.

### `function checkState`

The checkbox state of a node, after descendant propagation.
